messages:
maya (VP People): Quick post-all-hands thread on the reorg + headcount rollout. Keeping answers short so managers have a clear script to use in 1:1s.

sam (CTO): Topline: 28 net new roles this FY. Q2 concentrates on serving/runtime and infra to hit latency SLOs.

lisa (People Ops): Hiring cadence: Q2 burst (15 hires), Q3 steady (8), Q4 reserve (5). We’re prioritizing FTEs for core infra; contractors for short-term docs/UX.

maria (recruiter): Recruiters are shifting focus immediately. If you want agency help for senior runtime, DM me and include "urgent" + role req.

jordan (eng-manager): For managers: can we get one canonical before/after org CSV + recommended talking points?

maya (VP People): Yes  
 we will publish a team-mapping CSV and a 3-bullet manager script (what changed, why, who to contact) by EOD Wednesday.

diego (IC): How will internal transfers be handled? I’d like to apply without blocking my current team.

lisa (People Ops): Internal fast-track is real: reduced loop, 1 hiring manager interview, target decision in 2 weeks. Still expect handover plan with your current manager.

alex (product): Any change to compensation bands or relocation policy for these roles?

maya (VP People): Compensation bands unchanged. For critical hires we may approve relocation exceptions case-by-case; People Ops will note exceptions in the reqs.

sam (CTO): Interview bar for runtime: systems design + production inference shipping. Quantization/CUDA is a plus but not mandatory. Please use the new scorecard (rubric) when debriefing.

maria (recruiter): Scorecards + interview rubrics landing in #recruiting in 30m. Please use required fields: "decision", "score (1-5)", "concerns". No freeform-only debriefs.

jordan (eng-manager): Onboarding  will new hires be rostered oncall right away?

sam (CTO): No. Standard: 6-week shadow then gradual ramp into rotations. Exceptions for senior ICs.

harper (allhands-bot): :calendar: Event created: "Reorg+Hiring managers sync" Thu 11:00  maya, sam, lisa, maria.

maya (VP People): Action items for managers: 1) review rubrics when posted, 2) prepare 30/60/90 role goals, 3) nominate interviewers, 4) review CSV before 1:1s.

diego (IC): One more ask: can we have a public, read-only tracker of open reqs + stage (no candidate PII)? very helpful for cross-team referrals.

maria (recruiter): Will do. Read-only tracker (internal) posted tomorrow. Also weekly hiring sync invite for hiring managers.

maya (VP People): Thanks all  
 we want this to feel coordinated not disruptive. If you have sensitive concerns about reporting lines, DM Lisa or me and we’ll handle privately.
